calls.video_title: Why Is DigitalOcean Stock Falling and is it a Buying Opportunity?
calls.price_at_call: $122 DCF (stated) vs ~$102 current (stated); ~20% upside over 12-18 months (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked DOCN call for Parkevtate (no prior DOCN call in calls.json, so no formal tracked flip) — he upgrades DigitalOcean to a buy: on 13 May he had said it was too expensive, but the fall from ~$180 earlier in 2026 to ~$102 makes his updated $122 DCF attractive enough. Forward P/E 55 against forecast 50% revenue growth in 2027, with cash flow from operations still over 30% of sales.
calls.base_case: Management guides Q4 2026 revenue growth of 35%, up from 28% in the most recent quarter, and at least 50% growth in 2027; revenue has risen from ~$300m in 2021 to ~$1bn trailing twelve months.
calls.bull_case: Agentic AI and the shift to open-weight models are driving demand (customers value-maxing rather than token-maxing); R&D fell to 18.7% of revenue from 29% in 2022, so R&D can grow in dollars while shrinking as a share of accelerating revenue.
calls.bear_case: Growth is coming at the expense of operating margins as the company invests in capacity, so investors see it as investment-driven rather than organic; cash-flow-from-operations margin has fallen to 31% from a 39% peak.
